items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I saw Edith -- Edith is now appearing with the Black Broadway production.

ctx.x: You were saying about Lena Wilson, you think she's Edith Wilson's sister.

Yes, she is Edith Wilson's sister -- Edith Wilson who is the famous artist from the early -- about the turn of the century and I saw Edith -- Edith is now appearing with the Black Broadway production.
Are they touring now, the Black Broadway, they're not playing here in New York (inaudible).
